title: Vapouriz Premium Strawberry Bliss E-Liquid 10ml
description: Strawberry Bliss from Vapouriz delivers a luscious, fruity rush of sweet, succulent strawberries. Unlike the sharp, syrupy sweetness of many other strawberry e-juices, Strawberry Bliss captures the soft, plump, juicy berries at their authentic, summery best for a deliciously fruity vape. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly-crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Browse the full collection of Vapouriz Premium E-Liquids and pick up the perfect pairing for any Vape Kit , Starter Vape Kits or Compact Pod Vape Kit . We’ve got a selection of formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options.
